newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy initial Jan CPI seen at 0.1 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Italy initial Jan CPI seen at 0.1 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Italian January consumer prices are seen at a preliminary 0.1 percent month on month and 2.5/2.6 percent year on year based on data released by two sample cities on Monday, analysts said.

Final December data showed CPI growing a month on month rate of 0.1 percent and a year on year rate of 2.6 percent. The January provisional data compares with analysts' forecasts for 0.2 and 2.6 percent year on year.
The two cities, Turin and Trieste, have a combined weighting of 11.3 percent on the national index.
A further nine cities, which this time include Bari, will release their preliminary data on Tuesday. The 11 cities have a total weighting of 75.66 percent on the national index.
Final CPI is due from national statistics office Istat on February 4.
